title: Shape hunt
offscreen: Walk around the room without the tablet: "I spy a circle". Take turns, the child picks the shape too.

items.label: Something round
items.say: Look for something round, like a circle, and bring it here.

items.label: Something with corners
items.say: Now something with four corners, like a square.

items.label: Something with three points
items.say: And something with three points, like a triangle.

items.label: Something long and thin
items.say: Look for something long and thin.

items.label: Something round but flattened
items.say: Now something round but squashed, like an egg or a coin.

items.label: Something that stands up on its own
items.say: Something with flat sides that stands up on its own.

items.label: Something that rolls
items.say: And last, something that rolls. Try it on the rug!

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look, I'll wait for you here. One thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too. See you tomorrow.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it. See you tomorrow!
